name: how-to-guides
description: Write complete customer-facing how-to guides for one feature of a B2B software product (scheduling, invoicing, field service, healthcare, retail or any other B2B SaaS) and build them as branded PDFs. Follows a researched standard (DITA, Microsoft and Google style guides, Diátaxis, minimalism, plus lessons from support-team reviews): problem first, one How it works section, three-part steps with what you'll see, an AI callout for AI features, who a message comes from, and a troubleshooting table. Learns each behaviour from the code and the app read-only, and hands back questions, change requests and bugs for product. The build turns Markdown into a tagged PDF with covers, numbered steps, callouts and framed screenshots, and checks the guide against the standard. Includes a demo-data screenshot driver and a callout tool. Product-neutral: ships no brand; your logo, colours, font and house rules live in your own howto-brand.json.
